description: Agent Cybersecurity: submit backup and restore records with the backup policy: the policy with the critical systems that must be backed up, the days between restore tests, the days after which the last good backup is stale and its text; each backup job with the system, the day it last succeeded and whether a copy is kept apart from the primary; each restore test with the system, the day and the result (passed, partial or failed); each backup failure with the system, the day it failed, the day it was followed up and whether it was resolved; and optionally the day the record is read on. The signed report gives the critical systems with those covered and uncovered and the stale backups, the restore tests with the critical systems never restored with a pass, those past the cycle and those whose latest test did not pass, the backups with and without a separated copy, and every failure with those not followed up and those unresolved, and counts them, and names unproven backups: a critical system with no backup, a critical system with no passed restore test, a backup with no copy kept apart from the primary and a backup failure with no follow-up; then a last passed restore past the policy’s cycle, a latest restore test that did not pass, a backup that has not succeeded inside the policy’s days and a followed-up failure left unresolved, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No critical list, no restore tests, no failure record, a backup with no word on a separated copy, no restore cycle, no day read on or a backup with no last success leaves the backups unverified. This reads backup jobs, restore tests and failures system by system: wever_recovery-readiness-check reads recovery arrangements as described and marks backups, key recovery, export paths and restore steps ready, partial or missing with quotes, wever_rollback-path-check reads the way back for a failed task’s effects and wever_continuity-check reads an operator’s continuity arrangements. Verdict cyber_backup_unproven, cyber_backup_partial, cyber_backup_unverified or cyber_backup_proven. POST /api/cyber-backup-check. Reads the security records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, system scan, probe or external write. Agent Cybersecurity reads an organization’s own security records after the fact and checks them against the stated policy and against themselves: standing access, the secrets inventory, the component and patch record, the exported configuration, logging coverage, backup and restore evidence, a vendor’s security evidence and incident readiness. Beside it, the Agent Risk checks such as wever_risk-exposure-check read one planned action’s worst case and limits before it runs, while a cyber check reads security posture from the records; and the security reads elsewhere in the catalog keep their families, each named beside the check it meets. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-cybersecurity-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-cybersecurity/.

as_of.description: The day the records are read on, such as 2026-11-02.

separated.description: Whether a copy is kept apart from the primary.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

backup_age_days.description: Days after which the last good backup is stale.

critical.description: The systems that must be backed up.
